summary: graph: pad the KQ bias of the no-cache attention ( #30446 ) The no-cache attention pads K, V and the mask to 256, but T5 also adds a relative position bias of [n_tokens, n_tokens], so the add with KQ fails unless n_tokens divides the padded width. Pad the bias with zeros up to the KV dimension of the mask, like K and V. Website: https://llama.app Attestations: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/attestations/555921
body:
graph: pad the KQ bias of the no-cache attention ( #30446 )

The no-cache attention pads K, V and the mask to 256, but T5 also adds

a relative position bias of [n_tokens, n_tokens], so the add with KQ

fails unless n_tokens divides the padded width. Pad the bias with

zeros up to the KV dimension of the mask, like K and V.

summaryZh: llama.cpp发布b11600版本，解决了无缓存注意力机制（no-cache attention）中的KQ偏置填充问题。此前无缓存注意力将K、V与掩码填充至256，但T5模型引入的相对位置偏置因维度未对齐会导致相加失败。该修复将偏置用零填充至掩码的KV维度以保证计算正常。
